item.title: A Common CD36 Variant and the Genetic Landscape of Dilated Cardiomyopathy in Individuals of African Ancestry.
item.description: Importance Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a major cause of heart failure that disproportionately affects individuals of predominantly African ancestry, among whom familial clustering of disease is more pronounced relative to those of predominantly European ancestry. Truncating variants in TTN, which encodes the sarcomeric protein titin, are the most common established monogenic cause of DCM. A common CD36 nonsense variant enriched among individuals of African ancestry has also been shown to account for a substantial burden of DCM. Objective To compare the contribution of a CD36 nonsense variant to DCM risk with that of truncating variants in TTN and pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in other established genes for DCM.

item.title: 美国捐赠者心脏分配的成人医疗紧急度评分的制定和验证。
item.description: 重要性 在美国，五分之一的心脏移植候选人会死亡或未经移植而被除名。目前，捐献者的心脏是由基于 6 种状态的治疗系统进行分配的，该系统因风险分层有限且容易受到博弈的影响而受到批评。目的 根据客观医疗紧急度评分制定新的心脏分配政策，根据生理学和机械循环支持之间的相互作用对候选者进行排名。使用美国器官移植系统的数据设计、设置和参与者基于登记的观察性研究。 2019年1月至2025年8月的所有成人（年龄≥18岁）心脏移植候选者均被纳入，分为训练（2019-2023）、验证（2023-2024）和测试（2024-2025）数据集。主要结果和措施 估算了不进行移植的 6 周死亡率的边际结构模型（美国候选者风险评分 [US-CRS]）。

item.title: 医疗保险计划； 2026 年《综合拨款法》第 6219、6220 和 6224 条的实施 (CMS-4214-P)
item.description: 医疗保险计划；实施 2026 年综合拨款法 (CMS-4214-P) 第 6219、6220 和 6224 条 背景 2026 年 10 月 16 日，医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 发布了一项拟议规则，以实施 2026 年综合拨款法的关键部分，包括第 6220 条（要求加强和(REAL) 医疗服务提供者法案的准确列表）和第 6224 条（现代化并确保药房福利经理责任）。要求增强和准确的（真实）健康提供者法案列表（第 6220 条）：CMS 提议编纂法规以实施真实健康提供者法案，该法案从 2028 年合同年开始为 MA 组织制定了新的提供者目录验证和准确性要求。

item.title: 医学诊断成像中合成图像的质量评估和模型训练影响：系统评价
item.description: 结论：与之前仅限于特定疾病、成像方式或生成架构的综述不同，这篇综述提供了合成图像质量评估和下游模型性能的跨领域定量综合。目前，合成图像作为真实训练数据的补充比作为替代品更有价值，分类性能略有改善，分割收益较小，并且仅合成训练的性能通常较差。对于研究人员、开发人员和监管机构来说，这些发现强调了在合成图像管道转化为临床人工智能应用之前需要标准化的多方法图像质量评估、完整的报告和严格的外部验证。试用注册：PROSPERO CRD42023369125；结果：总共纳入 160 项研究。

item.title: 怀孕早期使用苯二氮卓类药物和先天性畸形的风险。
item.description: 背景 关于妊娠期使用苯二氮卓类药物引起的畸形的现有数据是相互矛盾的。目的 评估妊娠早期接触苯二氮卓类药物导致主要先天畸形的风险。设计基于人群的美国队列研究。设置 Medicaid (2000-2018) 和 Merative MarketScan (2003-2020) 数据库。参与者 怀孕前 90 天至产后 30 天的孕妇以及出生后 90 天的活产婴儿。测量 暴露定义为在妊娠早期至少服用 1 次苯二氮卓类药物。主要结局是先前与苯二氮卓类药物暴露相关的任何主要先天性畸形和器官特异性畸形。

item.title: 急性肾损伤的间歇或连续肾脏替代治疗。
item.description: 背景 危重患者急性肾损伤的首选肾脏替代治疗方法仍不确定。到第 90 天，间歇组有 203 名患者（78.1%）发生了重大肾脏不良事件，连续组有 197 名患者（71.6%）发生了重大肾脏不良事件（调整后的绝对风险差异，6.28 个百分点；95% 置信区间 [CI]，-1.22 至 13.79）。

item.title: Projected Effect of 2026 Federal Changes to the Childhood Immunization Schedule on Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infections in the United States.
item.description: Background The United States recently proposed changes to the recommendations for childhood hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccination. Objective To project the effect of vaccine policy changes, if fully implemented, on chronic HBV infections. Design Markov cohort state transition model of perinatal and childhood HBV infection. Data sources Published data on maternal HBV prevalence (0.4%) and hepatitis B surface antigen testing (99.5% sensitivity), childhood vaccine completion (universal birth-dose strategy: 91.1%; deferred strategy: 87.1%; shared decision-making strategy: 50.0%), and age-stratified risk for chronic HBV infection. Target population One-year birth cohort of U.S.-born infants ( n = 3.6 million). Time horizon 20 years. Intervention Universal birth-dose vaccination, deferred (2-month) vaccination, and vaccination through shared decision making.

item.title: Multi-site real-world performance of commercial AI for pulmonary and incidental pulmonary embolism detection
item.description: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet the real-world performance of FDA-cleared AI detection models remains incompletely characterized. Reference-standard labels were extracted from radiology reports using a validated LLM pipeline (97% accuracy, κ = 0.94). The PE model achieved 86.8% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity, with sensitivity declining from 99.3% for saddle emboli to 72.9% for subsegmental PE, and from 89.7% for acute to 65.3% for non-acute PE. The iPE model achieved 73.5% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity. Both models demonstrated lower sensitivity than FDA-clearance benchmarks while exceeding cleared specificity, with diminishing performance for peripheral and non-acute emboli mirroring known human reader limitations and underscoring the need for standardized post-market surveillance of AI-enabled medical devices.

item.title: Silent evaluation reveals context-dependent validity of automated metrics for AI-generated clinical messages
item.description: Evaluation of AI-generated patient communication lacks standardized frameworks, and automated metrics may not reflect clinical utility. We leveraged a staged rollout of GPT-generated draft responses (GDRs) to patient portal messages. Thirty primary care physicians received drafts from September 2023 to August 2024 under two conditions: an intervention group where AI drafts were displayed and edited (n = 21,073), and a non-displayed group where drafts were generated but never shown to physicians, who composed responses independently (n = 45,127). We evaluated messages using BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and Flesch Reading Ease, and then correlated automated metrics with blinded physician ratings of effectiveness, misunderstanding potential, and harm. In the intervention group, 2264 (11%) drafts were incorporated into final messages with high semantic alignment (BERTScore F1 = 0.93).

item.title: 术中多巴酚丁胺加去甲肾上腺素预防感染性休克术后急性肾损伤：一项随机临床试验。
item.description: 重要性 基于极低确定性的证据，国际指南建议使用多巴酚丁胺来治疗成人感染性休克和伴有持续低灌注的心功能障碍。缺乏关于术中多巴酚丁胺联合去甲肾上腺素与去甲肾上腺素对接受手术感染性休克患者术后感染源控制的影响的随机试验。目的 确定术中多巴酚丁胺联合去甲肾上腺素是否可以减轻接受手术源控制的感染性休克患者术后 7 天内的急性肾损伤（AKI）。设计、设置和参与者 这项在中国 39 家三级医院开展的随机、开放标签临床试验纳入了 2024 年 6 月至 2025 年 8 月期间接受手术源控制的感染性休克成人患者。随访于 2025 年 11 月 15 日结束。

item.title: Molecular predictors of minimal residual disease in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with quadruplet therapy
item.description: Quadruplet therapy, combining anti-CD38 antibodies, immunomodulatory drugs, proteasome inhibitors and dexamethasone, is now the standard induction treatment for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (NDMM). These MRD-associated transcriptomic features were independently validated in the CASSIOPEIA cohort. Whole-genome sequencing revealed both known (APOBEC mutagenesis, chromothripsis) and new genomic instability phenotypes validated in the MMRF cohort. A multimodal random forest model integrating genomic, transcriptomic and epigenomic features predicted MRD status after induction, with an area under the curve of 0.77, outperforming clinical and genomic models, while providing comparable discrimination and improved calibration relative to the transcriptomic and epigenomic models.

item.title: FDA Approves First-of-Its-Kind Chronic Hepatitis B Treatment
item.description: FDA today approved Hibsago (bepirovirsen) injection, in combination with existing antiviral therapy, to treat chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in certain adults without cirrhosis.

item.title: Global, regional and national burden of pertussis in 1990–2023: a Global Burden of Disease study
item.description: Despite long-standing immunization programs, pertussis remains a major cause of vaccine-preventable mortality, particularly among infants. Here we present a primary assessment of global pertussis incidence, mortality and disability-adjusted life years across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2023. We show that despite short-term pandemic-period fluctuations, the dominant global pattern from 1990 to 2023 was long-term decline: age-standardized mortality decreased by 61.2% and age-standardized incidence by 41.6%. Relative to the anomalously low pandemic-period estimates, incidence and mortality rebounded by 102.6% (95% uncertainty interval, 77.0–128.2%) and 66.1% (95% uncertainty interval, 2.4–174.5%), respectively, between 2020 and 2023. In 2023 alone, we estimated 18.9 million cases and 115,000 deaths attributable to pertussis.

item.title: 未经胰岛素治疗的 2 型糖尿病的连续血糖监测。
item.description: 背景 连续血糖监测 (CGM) 已被证明对 1 型糖尿病患者和其他接受胰岛素治疗的 2 型糖尿病患者有益，但其在治疗未接受胰岛素治疗的 2 型糖尿病患者中的作用还需要进一步研究。 CGM 组的平均 (±SD) 糖化血红蛋白水平从基线时的 8.8±1.3% 降至 26 周时的 7.2±1.1%，常规护理组从 8.7±1.2% 降至 8.0±1.4%（调整后的平均差，-0.9 个百分点；95% 置信区间 [CI]，-1.1 至 -0.6；P < 0.001）。

item.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Cardiovascular Conditions in Medicare Advantage In-Home Health Risk Assessments.
item.description: Background Medicare Advantage insurers conduct in-home health risk assessments (HRAs) to identify high-risk patients and facilitate appropriate care. Critics argue this practice increases risk-adjusted payments without improving quality. Comprehensive data on use of in-home HRAs and downstream treatment are lacking. Objective To examine trends in cardiovascular conditions diagnosed during in-home HRAs, characteristics associated with HRA-based diagnoses, and treatment rates after diagnoses. Design Cohort study. Setting Population-based. Participants Medicare Advantage beneficiaries. Measurements Using 100% Medicare claims, trends in the proportion of cardiovascular conditions diagnosed during in-home HRAs (vs. facility-based visits) were examined.

item.title: GUARD-LGG: a glioma upfront AI-driven radiotherapy response decipher for lower-grade glioma
item.description: Here we present GUARD-LGG, a machine learning model designed to predict early RT response in LGG before treatment. GUARD-LGG achieved AUCs of 0.946 (95% CI: 0.938–0.962), 0.929 (95% CI: 0.894–0.965), 0.882 (95% CI: 0.830–0.934), and 0.913 (95% CI: 0.878–0.949) in the training, internal validation, external, and prospective test sets, respectively.

item.title: 通过持续学习重新利用成人人工智能射线照相模型进行新生儿护理：一项国际多中心研究
item.description: 在这里，我们对来自 20 个国家和地区 30 个新生儿重症监护病房的新生儿胸片进行了一项国际回顾性研究，评估了持续学习作为一种隐私保护方法，以将成人气管插管评估的深度学习模型应用于新生儿护理。持续学习在 30 个站点中的 29 个站点中实现了较低的解剖标志定位误差（医院特定微调为 0.67 厘米，对于仅限成人模型为 4.30 厘米），并在 30 个站点中的 27 个站点中改进了深部插管的检测。

item.title: 机械通气危重成年患者的液体治疗。
item.description: 重要性 液体治疗在重症监护病房 (ICU) 中无处不在，但存在风险，特别是对于机械通气患者。目前全球在剂量、适应症和类型方面的实践尚不清楚。目的 描述 ICU 成人机械通气液体操作的特点。设计、设置和参与者 2024 年 4 月至 2025 年 7 月期间在六大洲 41 个国家的 206 个 ICU 中进行的国际前瞻性观察队列研究。入ICU后3天内连续接受有创机械通气且通气24小时或更长时间的成年患者。排除标准是年龄小于 16 岁并且从另一个 ICU 转入机械通气。暴露 插管后的液体量、适应症和类型。主要结局和指标 主要指标包括（1）插管后 7 天内的总输液量和每日液体平衡；

item.title: FDA 批准免疫疗法可让某些直肠癌患者避免化疗、放疗和手术
item.description: 美国食品和药物管理局今天加速批准免疫疗法 Jemperli (dostarlimab-gxly) 的新用途，该疗法可能使一些局部晚期直肠癌患者避免对其日常生活产生持久影响的常见治疗。

item.title: Individualized Cardiac Index-Guided Hemodynamic Therapy in High-Risk Patients Undergoing Elective Major Abdominal Surgery: The PELICAN Randomized Clinical Trial.
item.description: Importance It remains unclear if intraoperative hemodynamic therapy should be guided by cardiac index. Objective To evaluate whether individualized cardiac index-guided hemodynamic therapy vs routine hemodynamic therapy improves outcomes in high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery. Design, setting, and participants This multicenter, single-blind, superiority randomized clinical trial enrolled high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery between October 8, 2023, and October 25, 2025, at 12 university medical centers in Austria, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, and Spain. The date of last follow-up was January 15, 2026. Interventions Patients were randomized to individualized cardiac index-guided hemodynamic therapy targeting the patient's preoperative resting cardiac index vs routine hemodynamic therapy (with blinded cardiac index monitoring).

item.title: 报告评估医学大语言模型干预的临床试验的完整性：系统评价。
item.description: 目的 使用既定的报告指南来描述涉及大语言模型 (LLM) 干预的临床试验的报告完整性。设计系统回顾和元研究分析。数据来源 在书目数据库（Embase、Medline 和 CENTRAL）中检索试验报告和方案，在试验注册中心（ClinicalTrials.gov 和世界卫生组织国际临床试验注册平台）中检索 2017 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 12 月 6 日期间发布的试验注册。 资格标准 描述 LLM 医学干预临床试验的试验报告、试验方案和试验注册。

item.title: 加压素起始阈值对感染性休克死亡率的影响：VASSPR 集群交叉随机策略试验。
item.description: 重要性 对于感染性休克患者，开始使用第二种血管升压药的最佳升压药剂量尚不确定。干预 医院层面实施感染性休克管理策略，建议当其他血管升压药的总剂量达到去甲肾上腺素或等效物 0.1 µg/kg/min 或等效物（较低阈值策略）或其他血管升压药的总剂量达到去甲肾上腺素或等效物 0.4 µg/kg/min 时（较高阈值策略），开始固定剂量加压素。
